title: The finite representative square on arbitrary K-flat pairs
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a map f:X→Y with l invertible on X and Y, and n≥0. For arbitrary K-flat finite-coefficient cochain complexes P,Q whose ordinary termwise pullbacks are K-flat, the prescribed finite derived pullback tensor comparison satisfies the representative square with the ordinary factors of FinitePullbackTensorRep, the inverse ordinary total comparison, and exactly the chosen finiteIntrinsicTensorModels comparisons. No termwise flatness is assumed.

proof.text: The uniquely normalized flat representative comparison followed by its tensor-model identification is the restriction of the prescribed finiteIntrinsicTensorModels comparison.
Use the two natural composites on the full subcategory of K-flat inputs with K-flat ordinary pullbacks.

Choose flat-term K-flat resolutions of both inputs. Their pullbacks are flat-term K-flat. The existing flat representative square gives equality on the resolutions; naturality and cancellation of the invertible localized resolution tensor map give equality on the original inputs.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePullbackTensor_ringed_kflat_square {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (P Q : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P)
    (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) Q)
    (hFP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      ((FinitePullbackTensorRep.pull l E f n).obj P))
    (hFQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
      ((FinitePullbackTensorRep.pull l E f n).obj Q)) :
    (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
        ((finiteIntrinsicTensorModels l E Y n).iso (ProEt.topology Y)
          (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n)
          P Q hP hQ).hom ≫
      ((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)).hom ≫
      (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map (Prod.mkHom
        ((FinitePullbackTensorRep.factors l E f n).hom.app P)
        ((FinitePullbackTensorRep.factors l E f n).hom.app Q)) =
    (FinitePullbackTensorRep.factors l E f n).hom.app
        (FinitePullbackTensorRep.tensor l E Y n P Q) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (FinitePullbackTensorRep.comparison l E f n P Q) ≫
      ((finiteIntrinsicTensorModels l E X n).iso (ProEt.topology X)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n) (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n)
        ((FinitePullbackTensorRep.pull l E f n).obj P)
        ((FinitePullbackTensorRep.pull l E f n).obj Q) hFP hFQ).hom
